subject: general
question: Which of the following is secreted directly into the blood and carried to different parts of the body?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adrenaline**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adrenaline** is a hormone secreted by the adrenal glands directly into the bloodstream.
 
• It is commonly known as the "fight or flight" hormone because it helps the body respond to stressful situations.
 
• Adrenaline increases the heart rate, expands air passages in the lungs, dilates the pupils, and redirects blood flow to muscles, preparing the body for immediate action.
 
• This hormone plays a critical role in regulating metabolic processes and maintaining homeostasis during emergencies.
 
• Unlike other substances like pancreatic juice, bile juice, or saliva, which are secreted into ducts, adrenaline is released directly into the bloodstream.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pancreatic Juice:**

 
 
• Pancreatic juice contains digestive enzymes such as amylase, lipase, and protease.
 
• It is secreted by the pancreas into the small intestine through the pancreatic duct.
 
• This juice helps in the digestion of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins in the duodenum.
 
• Unlike adrenaline, it is not secreted directly into the bloodstream but into the digestive tract.
 
 
 
• **Bile Juice:**
 
 
• Bile juice is produced by the liver and stored in the gallbladder.
 
• It is secreted into the small intestine through the bile duct and helps in emulsifying fats for digestion.
 
• Bile juice contains bile salts, bile pigments, and cholesterol but is not released into the bloodstream.
 
 
 
• **Saliva:**
 
 
• Saliva is secreted by salivary glands into the mouth.
 
• It contains enzymes like salivary amylase, which begin the digestion of starch.
 
• Saliva is involved in the process of chewing and swallowing but is not released into the bloodstream.
 
 
 
• **Adrenal Glands:**
 
 
• Adrenal glands are small triangular glands located on top of the kidneys.
 
• They produce hormones like adrenaline, noradrenaline, cortisol, and aldosterone.
 
• Adrenaline and noradrenaline are secreted directly into the bloodstream to regulate stress responses.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Functions of Adrenaline:**

 
 
• Adrenaline helps in increasing blood sugar levels by stimulating glycogen breakdown in the liver.
 
• It enhances oxygen supply to the brain and muscles during stressful situations.
 
• It suppresses non-essential functions like digestion during emergencies to conserve energy.
 
 
 
• **Medical Applications:**
 
 
• Adrenaline is used in emergency medicine to treat severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis).
 
• It is also used in certain cardiac conditions to stimulate the heart during a cardiac arrest.
